english.title: Fly aeroplane at altitude as would not enable it to reach a place it could safely land in event of engine failure
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aeroplane registered in the United Kingdom and flying for the purpose of public transport, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which did not flyat such an altitude as would enable the aeroplane,

(C)_[having one engine only, in the event of the failure of that engine,]_
(D)_[having more than one engine, in the event of the failure of one of those engines and with the remaining engine or engines operating within the maximum continuous power conditions specified in the certificate of airworthiness or flight manual for the aeroplane,]_

to reach a place at which it could safely land at a height sufficient to enable it to do so.
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 127(6) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
